notes:
Fixed: Anabasis, Epitomes, Sigils and Vesta Blessing were each showing a different item entirely - all four now read the item they name
Fixed: On Wars was a blended figure that stored as 0 on almost every account - it is a straight count of On War items now
New: Silver Keys has its own column
Every sidebar and top-bar icon redrawn as one matching set - no more emoji
New loading screen, with a progress bar that tracks something real
Your tier now shows in the sidebar on every tab, with supporters thanked and a link to their key
Start and stop are colour coded without hovering
Your name or avatar opens the licence page; that page is much shorter
Requires relaunching your bots: the new script only takes effect when a bot next starts
